text:
elena_pm: getting ahead of the pilot contract negotiations. Legal pushed back: they want data residency + KMS control for the enterprise tenant. We have 6 weeks to deliver a pilot-safe MVP. Can we scope a pragmatic minimal acceptance package?

mike_eng: quick take: KMS integration (customer-managed keys) is non-trivial but scoped: backend + deploy config ~2.5 weeks. Data residency (US/EU region pinning) is mostly infra config if we restrict pilot to one region.

harper_security: risk note: customer-managed KMS + S3 export + logs in separate region -> key policy complexity. Recommend we offer KMS in MVP only for the enterprise pilot, with a signed security addendum.

leo_ops: operational constraints: we need an ops playbook for key rotation and runbooks for cross-region exports. Can deliver a "manual rotation" guide in MVP, automation in v1.

zoe_sales: customer asks: 1) SSO + KMS, 2) per-tenant retention 90 days, 3) SLA for inference 99.9. They are willing to sign pilot terms if we provide a clear acceptance test and a rollback clause.

nate_support: support impact: if we limit admin UI, we'll need a self-serve config file they can upload or we provide a one-off onboarding run. That reduces time to ship versus building UI.

mike_eng: propose: MVP package for pilot enterprise = {SSO, per-tenant nightly export (S3 in pinned region), customer-managed KMS support, 90d retention policy enforced at export, model pinning config file}. No admin console. Acceptance test = successful end-to-end export + SSO auth test + sample inference within latency SLO.

harper_security: add requirement: security review signoff + HSM/KMS policy checklist. We'll attach a branded addendum that limits our liability and lists key handling responsibilities.

elena_pm: timeline check: can infra + backend deliver the export + KMS wiring in 3 wks and FE + docs in 1 wk? That fits the 6-week pilot signup if legal signs the addendum.

mike_eng: backend sprint plan: Week1 (KMS prototype + export schema), Week2 (export pipeline + S3 region pinning), Week3 (tests + infra hardening). FE + onboarding guide parallel in Week2-3.

leo_ops: ops deliverables: manual rotation guide (doc), export validation script (ops-run), and a short runbook for incident response. ETA: end of Week3.

zoe_sales: I'll push the acceptance criteria into the pilot LOI and confirm customer acceptance. Also ask for a 2-week validation window post-launch before they declare pilot success.

elena_pm: decision proposal: lock MVP pilot scope for this enterprise tenant only: SSO + nightly exports to pinned region with CMK support + 90d retention + model pinning via config file. Defer admin console, streaming logs, autoscale, and billing UI to v1.

mike_eng: one caveat: we need a short agreed SLA addendum: inference SLA applies; export delivery best-effort with documented expected latency ("exports within 2-6 hours after window"). Otherwise we risk escalation on delivery.

harper_security: approved with the addendum language. Also recommend an allowlist for any SSH/console access during onboarding.

nate_support: action items for support: onboarding checklist template, failover contacts, and a simple dashboard alert for failed exports.

elena_pm: action items (owners + due dates):
- @mike_eng: deliver KMS + export prototype (due = +2w)
- @leo_ops: ops runbook + validation script (due = +3w)
- @zoe_sales: get LOI signed with acceptance criteria (due = +1w)
- @harper_security: produce security addendum draft (due = +5 days)
- @nate_support: onboarding checklist (due = +10 days)

pm-bot: Reminder: PM sync Thursday 10:30am.

elena_pm: if we hit any blocker that increases scope (e.g., need admin UI), call an immediate scope review. Otherwise we'll lock this tenant-specific MVP and create a follow-up ticket to generalize for later tenants. :white_check_mark:
